prompt: A support post meets a straight steel beam, forming a linear pair of angles on one side of the beam. If one of those angles is $110^\circ$, what is the other, in degrees?
hint: A linear pair sits along a straight line, and a straight line measures $180^\circ$.

hints.text: A linear pair sits along a straight line, and a straight line measures $180^\circ$.

explanation: Two angles that form a linear pair are supplementary: they add to $180^\circ$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Picture the straight beam
steps: Lay a protractor along the beam: end to end is $180^\circ$.
The post eats $110^\circ$ of that, so $70^\circ$ is left over on the other side.
